attempts.summary: Configured daily logrotate for /var/log/inventory/app.log on node1 with 7 compressed rotations and copytruncate (no live writer process was found, so copytruncate is the safe mechanism to let the app keep writing post-rotation). Verified end-to-end functionally, then completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified config persistence, prior log data, timer activity, and rotation function post-restart.
